[color=#f4f4f4]2, Open the folder and copy the .ogg files[/color]
[color=#f4f4f4]2, Go to your mods -> TractorMod -> assets -> audio [/color]
[color=#f4f4f4]3, Paste[/color]
[color=#f4f4f4]5, I[/color]t should ask to replace the files, say yes

[color=#f4f4f4]And just like that your done ! Now go ahead and enjoy your brand new plough :D ![/color]
